verdict.rationale: Daytona documents an official CLI providing command-line access to sandbox lifecycle, snapshots, and other core features, and this CLI is also integrated into an agent-skill workflow alongside SDKs and API. Community evidence corroborates hands-on CLI usage (favorable comparison to DevPod for command-line users), though one report flags install-script quality issues unrelated to CLI functionality itself. Missing for 10: deeper independent third-party validation of CLI feature completeness and no explicit AI-native command examples beyond agent-skill reference.
